additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0434020 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
As reported by the end customer, the connector end on the left detaches from the cable. We would like to inform you that, according to the charger configuration, the cable length is 5.0m and 400A (Peak). The cable length will remain the same as the previous one.
We kindly request you to order the spare part mentioned below according to the configuration. Please confirm before placing the order.
Kindly find the attached MLFB for your reference:
8EM5903-0AA02-6AA2
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
